d:
Bihar ki rajdhani patna men varshon se jama kachre ke pahar ko ab oorja utpadan ke avsar men badalne ki taiyari hai. shahar ke ramchak bairiya men vest-tu-enarji plant sthapit kiya jaega, jahan kachre se 15 megavat bijli ka utpadan hoga.
